details.description: Zephyr-7B-β is a 7-billion-parameter chat model from Hugging Face's H4 team, released in October 2023 as the second model in the Zephyr series after Zephyr-7B-α. It is a fine-tune of Mistral AI's Mistral-7B-v0.1, aligned with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on the synthetic UltraChat dialogue dataset and the UltraFeedback preference dataset, without additional safety RLHF or in-the-loop response filtering. Hugging Face positioned it at release as one of the strongest chat models at the 7B parameter scale on MT-Bench and AlpacaEval.
advantages: Scores 61.07% on MMLU (5-shot), per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 84.36% on HellaSwag (10-shot), per its Hugging Face model card.
Hugging Face reports an MT-Bench score of 7.34 and a 90.60% win rate on AlpacaEval, which it describes as the highest among 7B chat models at release.
disadvantages: Trained without safety RLHF or in-the-loop response filtering, so per its model card it can produce problematic outputs, especially when explicitly prompted to.
Card states it is weaker on complex coding and mathematics tasks.
Documented and evaluated primarily in English.
use_cases: General-purpose chat and conversational assistant applications
Research on preference-alignment techniques such as Direct Preference Optimization

notes: MT-Bench (0-10 scale) and AlpacaEval (a win-rate percentage against a reference model, akin to an arena rating) are not accuracy-style 0-100 scores, so they are kept out of evaluations and mentioned in advantages instead with attribution. The model card does not state a numeric context-length figure directly; catalog's 32768 max input/output tokens is kept as authoritative and not contradicted by anything found. Verify pass: the model card's own "Model Sources" section lists https://github.com/huggingface/alignment-handbook as this model's "Repository" (the training/reproduction code), so github_url was corrected from null to that URL.
